g.title: FCS_QSP
g.text: Familial Chylomicronemia Syndrome (FCS) — Integrated QSP Mechanistic Map
21 clusters · 222 nodes · 290 edges · one saturated clearance capacity: CL_total = CL_LPL(genotype ~ 0) + CL_independent(apoC-III, saturable)
